note: Calibrated from a real Serum 2 editor captured via the Mosh host (Mosh --demo3 → open_plugin_editor → screencapture the 'Serum 2' window), Init patch. Coords are in the reference_size pixel space (a retina capture); load_profile() scales them to the actual frame. Serum draws a WHITE pointer mark over a small blue arc; pointer="white" reads the colourless pointer (bright + low-saturation) for accurate absolute values (full SUSTAIN reads ~1.0). ENV 1 has no DELAY knob (unlike Vital): ATK/HOLD/DEC/SUS/REL. Extend by adding controls.
